chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: Williams and Walker, Sissle and Blake: not involved
summary: He says Williams and Walker were before his time and that Sissle and Blake were on at the time of Blackbirds but he had no involvement.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What about Williams and Walker -- were you involved with them at all?
No, that was before my time.
And how about Sissle and Blake?
They were on at the same time I was in "Blackbirds," something
But you had no involvement, you yourself?
